WHAT: Native iOS keyboard letter font renders at ~15pt glyph height; 22pt .light in SF Pro matches this

MEASUREMENTS (from keyboard_diff.py):
- Native glyph height: 15.0-17.0pt depending on letter
- At 22pt .light: 0 delta on height for Q/W/E/R/T row
- Width still 0.3-1.7pt wider than native (Q is outlier +1.7pt due to tail)
- At 25pt regular (OLD): +7-11px glyph height delta — visibly wrong
- At 22.5pt: still too big

CODE: `letterKeyFont` constant in KeyboardViewController.swift
  `UIFont.systemFont(ofSize: 22, weight: .light)`

GOTCHA: Glyph HEIGHT matches native at 22pt .light. WIDTH still slightly wider — this is font rendering subtlety, not a fixable size issue.
